question: If 15 men working at the same rate can manufacture 27 baskets in an hour, how many baskets would 45 men manufacture in 40 minutes?

In 60 minutes 15 men can do 27 baskets


So, In 1 min 1 man can do =27/(60*15)


So, In 40 minutes 45 men can do =27*40*45/60*15


=54

question: If the product of 3 consecutive integers is 120, then the sum of the integers is :

(x-1)× x × (x+1)= 120
=> (x²-1)x = 120
=> x³ - x = 120
∴x= 5 , Check 5³-5 = 125-5 = 120.
So, x=5. The other two numbers are 4 and 6 which are equal to x-1 and x+1 respectively.
Now the total of these numbers is 3x=3×5=15.
